title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Sexual Relations with a Client
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal agrees to represent an individual in a small claims matter. One month into the retainer, the paralegal and the client begin a romantic and sexual relationship. They had no prior relationship before the retainer. Is this an ethical violation?
options: No, as long as the relationship is consensual.
No, because the client is not considered vulnerable in a small claims matter.
Yes, it is a conflict of interest and an abuse of the power imbalance inherent in the paralegal-client relationship.
Yes, but the paralegal can cure the violation by offering their services for free.
questions.explain: The Law Society views sexual relations with a client (that commence after the legal retainer begins) as a serious conflict of interest and professional misconduct, due to the inherent power imbalance and fiduciary nature of the legal representative-client relationship.
